title: Centella Cream for Indian Skin: A Simple Guide to Cica
ex: Centella asiatica, or cica, is the calming plant behind many Korean creams. See who a cica cream suits in Indian weather and how to use it.
rt: Centella (Cica) Cream for Indian Skin | Mirc Glow
rd: Centella cream for Indian skin: what cica is, why Korean skincare loves it, who it suits in summer, monsoon and AC weather, and how to use a cica cream daily.
quick: A centella cream, or cica cream, uses the centella asiatica plant to help skin feel calm, comfortable and moisturised. It suits most Indian skin types, especially oily or sensitive skin in heat and dry skin in AC. Use a pea-sized amount morning or night, with sunscreen in the day.
facts: Centella asiatica is also called gotu kola, and cica for short.
Korean skincare made cica popular as a calming step.
Light gel-cream textures suit oily skin in summer and monsoon.
Cica works well alongside niacinamide and hyaluronic acid.
